newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria jails Briton 10 years for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria jails Briton 10 years for drugs.

text.p: A British national on Thursday was sentenced to 10 years in prison in Nigeria for smuggling marijuana, the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reported.
John Nolan, 48, was sentenced along with three Nigerians in Lagos by a special tribunal that handles drugs and similar cases.
A British embassy spokesman said his sentence would commence from September 1994 when he was arrested. The spokesman did not know Nolan's hometown in Britain.
NAN reported that Nolan's lawyer pleaded for leniancy, saying Nolan was a hardworking man back in England and his 74-year-old mother had expressed regret that she might not see him again.
But the court said there was no doubt from evidence before the tribunal that Nolan was a "professional smuggler," the agency reported.
Nigeria imposes long jail terms for offences relating to drugs.
